categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Changes core P2P message handling in src/net_processing.cpp by decomposing PeerManagerImpl::ProcessMessage().
categories.rationale: Decomposing the monolithic ProcessMessage into per-message member functions improves navigation and scoping, but does not retire a known hazard or affect relay correctness or DoS resistance. Within P2P, where attack resistance and relay performance dominate, move-only code reorganization has no special claim on scarce review attention.
